title: What I Think, and So
label: ch:te-what-i-think-and-so
canDo: I can say what I think, firmly or softly, with ani anukuṇṭunnānu, nā abhiprāyaṁlō and anipistundi, and give a result with kābaṭṭi and andukē.

payoff.summary: Complete TE-R318-opinion-and-result: give an opinion three ways and draw a result from a reason with kābaṭṭi and andukē.
